cd /app/tmp && python3 - << 'EOF'
import json, random
rnd = random.Random(3)
Q,L,R,U = 16,8,32,2**31
borders=[0]+sorted(rnd.sample(range(1,U),R-1))+[U]
# all same rank, 40000 steps x 3 arrivals, capacity 20000, epoch 1
steps=[];t=0;nid=0
for k in range(40000):
    t+=1
    lanes=rnd.sample(range(L),3); arr=[]
    for ln in lanes:
        arr.append({"id":"s%d"%nid,"lane":ln,"rank":12345}); nid+=1
    steps.append({"t":t,"serve":True,"arrivals":arr})
json.dump({"mode":"stream","banks":Q,"lanes":L,"limit":U,"borders":borders,
           "capacity":20000,"epoch":1,"steps":steps}, open("tie_stream.json","w"))
# same but capacity 1 (max drops)
json.dump({"mode":"stream","banks":Q,"lanes":L,"limit":U,"borders":borders,
           "capacity":1,"epoch":1,"steps":steps}, open("drop_stream.json","w"))
# burst 120000 packets all same rank
packets=[{"id":"t%d"%i,"lane":i%L,"rank":12345} for i in range(120000)]
json.dump({"mode":"burst","banks":Q,"lanes":L,"limit":U,"borders":borders,
           "start_bank":0,"packets":packets}, open("tie_burst.json","w"))
print("ok")
EOF
for f in tie_stream drop_stream tie_burst; do echo "== $f"; python3 memcheck.py $f.json; done
